title: idcorrelated_reply_resolves_and_badargs_rejects
description:
## Behavior
success path resolves values in DOM; bad-args path rejects; IPCERR\techo\tBadArgs row on stdout; full m8_reply_channel_test.py PASSES (was vacuous SKIP)

## Given / When / Then
- **Given:** WebView2 bridge active; zbhost.js sendViaWebView2 tracks pending requests by id
- **When:**  a request id=N is dispatched, and separately an echo with bad args ({} or {msg:42})
- **Then:**  win_backend posts {id:N,result:...}; zbhost.js resolves ONLY the matching promise; bad args => {id:M,error:'BadArgs'} rejects the matching promise; never resolves the wrong id

## Edge Cases
- two concurrent in-flight requests resolve to correct ids (no cross-talk)
- reply for unknown id ignored
- error reply carries BadArgs, not generic failure

title: Epic: zigBrowser Slice 3/4 — IPC command surface + cross-OS backends
description:
## Goal
Expand the JS<->Zig IPC command surface and add REAL Windows (WebView2) and macOS (WKWebView) backends that reuse the same OS-agnostic Zig core (ipc.zig, nav_policy.zig) verbatim. Builds on the now-live seam (994f7a2/3c8dbe8: Zig modules hard-linked, nm-verified, C fallbacks removed). Every milestone ends in a human-observable artifact (rendered text, real-pixel screenshot, protocol line, exit code), never "tests green" alone.

## Plan
- Plan file: thoughts/searchable/shared/plans/2026-05-31-18-00-ENG-0005-tdd-ipc-surface-and-cross-os-backends-slice3-4.md
- Test framework: Zig 0.16 std.testing (zig build test) + Python E2E harness (tests/e2e, --e2e-protocol) + pillow nonuniform PNG oracle
- Build order: M1 echo -> M2 error reply -> M3 nav traversal block -> M4 backend select -> M5 no-backend hard-fail -> M6 timeout recovery -> M7 cancel-on-close -> M8 Windows WebView2 -> M9 macOS WKWebView

## Scope (behaviors)
- echo command roundtrip
- typed error reply rejects the JS promise
- cross-OS-shared nav traversal block
- build selects exactly one backend by target
- build hard-fails when no backend is linked
- per-backend load-timeout recovery
- cancel-in-flight load on window close
- Windows WebView2 backend opens a real window and answers ping (HW gate: Windows CI)
- macOS WKWebView backend renders a real page and answers ping (HW gate: macOS CI)

## Definition of Done
- All child behavior beads closed
- Plan success criteria satisfied; N+1 error-path coverage met
- zig build test + GTK E2E + build-selection tests green; no new duplication
- M8/M9 ship if Win/macOS CI available, else split to a hardware-provisioned Slice 4 (not stubbed)
